One scope.</text> <g transform="translate(64 205)"> <rect width="1152" height="330" fill="none" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="3"/> <path d="M0 82H1152M0 164H1152M0 246H1152M420 0V330M690 0V330M930 0V330" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="2"/> <g fill="#6c7478" font-size="20"><text x="26" y="51">TOOL</text><text x="448" y="51">READ</text><text x="718" y="51">WRITE</text><text x="958" y="51">CLOSE</text></g> <g fill="#17222d" font-size="24" font-weight="700"><text x="26" y="135">ticket_search</text><text x="26" y="217">ticket_comment</text><text x="26" y="299">ticket_close</text></g> <g font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace" font-size="34" font-weight="700"><text x="488" y="135" fill="#277187">YES</text><text x="758" y="135" fill="#6c7478">NO</text><text x="998" y="135" fill="#6c7478">NO</text><text x="488" y="217" fill="#277187">YES</text><text x="758" y="217" fill="#d9572b">OWN</text><text x="998" y="217" fill="#6c7478">NO</text><text x="488" y="299" fill="#277187">YES</text><text x="758" y="299" fill="#6c7478">NO</text><text x="998" y="299" fill="#d9572b">GATE</text></g> </g></g>
